scope.rationale: D176.3 implements the recursive JSON shape writer and per-object scoped name validation in Query/Json plus the minimal focused writer tests. JsonShapeWriterTests exercises the writer directly with a fake IDataRecord (recursion, scope validation, presence, Base64, array guards); JsonStreamingTests is the SQLite end-to-end terminal that proves nested object/locally-scoped names and the flat phase-1 regression surface through the two changed source files. No other compiled inputs are touched.
scope.boundary: Full affected project sweep C02 (dotnet test tests/nextorm.core.tests -c Debug, no filter, --no-build after the solution build) after the last edit; the SQLite/JSON inner classes are re-run after every coherent edit, and the filtered SQLite JsonStreamingTests run confirms the end-to-end JSON terminal.
